newsitem.title: USA: CEEE Group goes to Delaware, changes name.
newsitem.headline: CEEE Group goes to Delaware, changes name.

text.p: CEEE Group Corp said Tuesday its shareholders approved the company's merger into its wholly owned subsidiary Atlantic International Entertainment Ltd.
The purpose is to move the corporation to Delaware, where Atlantic International is based, said CEEE Chief Executive Richard Iamunno.
"The laws governing public corporations are more advantageous in Delaware than in Colorado," Iamunno said.
Each three shares of common stock will be exchanged for one share of Atlantic International common stock, he said.
CEEE Group develops and markets Internet-based products.
